text:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up — the embedding-service error-rate alert has been firing ~every 10m for the past 6 hours, mostly 429s during bulk-upsert jobs. Can we consider a short threshold bump or transition to a rate-based alert?
Ethan Lee: I saw that too. 429s correlate with the nightly backfill at 03:30 UTC. spikes are short (~2-3m).
Priya Nair: Link to alert and dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/embeddings/embedding-service?orgId=1
Priya Nair: Current alert: alerts/EMBED-429-high — fires if 429_count / total_requests > 0.05 over 5m.
Maria Gomez: Proposal: change to 0.08 over 5m and add a secondary alert for sustained (>30m) 429 ratio at 0.05. That should suppress transient backfill noise but keep prolonged regressions.
Samir Rao: @Maria are we comfortable with 8%? Any customer impact observed?
Ethan Lee: Checked logs — most 429s are 429 rate-limit from internal worker clients (bulk). Not affecting normal host traffic. No customer 5xx reports so far.
Priya Nair: Also we could change the alerting window from 5m -> 3m for burst tolerance, or add a tag to ignore jobs with header X-Internal-Worker. Which do we prefer?
Maria Gomez: Prefer threshold bump + a suppression rule for requests with header X-Internal-Worker so long-running backfills don't noisify. Simpler than changing window semantics.
Samir Rao: Sounds reasonable. I can approve a short-term change (48h) to 0.08 and the suppression rule as a temporary guard. Will need a PR for terraform-alerts.
Ethan Lee: I'll open the PR now. config diff will be small:
```
alert "EMBED-429-high" {
  expr = "sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"embed-svc\",status=~\"429\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"embed-svc\"}[5m])) > 0.08"
  for = "5m"
}
# suppression: ignore requests with header X-Internal-Worker in metric labels
```
Priya Nair: Tagging runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/embeddings#429-troubleshoot — add note about backfill filter.
Maria Gomez: @Samir after PR lands can you apply and monitor for the next 24h and rollback if any customer-facing regressions?
Samir Rao: Yep. I'll deploy once PR passes CI. I'll also add a Grafana alert panel showing p50/p95 latencies and request throughput to spot regressions quickly.
deploy-bot: PR #4827 merged by Ethan Lee — terraform-alerts/EMBED-429-high threshold updated to 0.08 (deploy queued).
obs-bot: Alert suppression rule for X-Internal-Worker created as experimental flag (id: sup-emb-2026).
Samir Rao: Applied change at 1959995120. Monitoring now.
Ethan Lee: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a short post in #eng-sre after 24h with whether we should make this permanent. :thumbsup:
Maria Gomez: :thumbsup: thanks — closing this thread once we confirm the noise drops.
